notes.title: Keybind Update
notes.content: Added support for arrow keys and Numpad number keys in keyboard bindings.

notes.title: Faraday Protocol now available for Linux and SteamOS!
notes.content:
Good Day Archaeologists!

We bring good news to fans of penguin-based computing!

Faraday Protocol is out NOW for Linux-based systems (which includes Valve's SteamOS as well)! So if you're a Linux gamer, you won't have to rely on Wine or Proton to check out and enjoy Faraday Protocol 💖.
Just install or update the game from your library as normal and if you're on Linux you should automatically get the new native build.

Let us know what you think - either here on the Steam forums or on Discord, we'd love to hear your thoughts!

We wish you a great day and a great time on OPIS! 💖

notes.title: 25% Off During Steam Autumn Sale
notes.content:
Good Day Archaeologists!

We're happy to announce that we're part of this years' Steam Autumn Sale! As such from today until December 1st, you can get Faraday Protocol for 25% off! 

This is the perfect opportunity for you to check out the game if you haven't yet, especially since we released our big Quality-of-Life Update not too long ago, bringing with it more puzzles and a much, much smoother experience than before.

Check it out if you like and let us know your thoughts and opinions! 

We hope everyone of you will have a great time of discovering OPIS for yourselves!

notes.title: Patch Notes for November 12th
notes.content:
Good day archaeologists!

Today we have a minor patch for the current QoL-Update for you! This one not only fixes some minor issues with players getting stuck in rare cases, but also brings with it another community-requested change!
In our mission to reduce plattforming and improve actual puzzle-solving we completely redesigned the puzzle in Chapter 6 Level 4! Have a small sneak peek right here!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39360336/e809be90b9d3225fbed2fb329717a7a83835d226.png

As always: thank you so very much for your support and we all hope that you'll continue to enjoy your time on OPIS! 💖

notes.title: Quality-of-Life Update!
notes.content:
Good Day Archaeologists!

It is time to present you our first major update for Faraday Protocol! The QoL-Update focuses on bringing our level designs to the next level by addressing one of the major issues our players had with some of the puzzles: the platforming segments!

Many puzzle rooms have been redesigned and tweaked by either reducing the amount of platforming you have to do or even by removing full platforming segments and replacing them with new and exciting puzzles!

Take a quick look at the changes right here!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39360336/0e79e5bdff393b230a930c1c0d380068dd5dbb18.gif

In addition to those major changes, we also fixed and tweaked some minor issues and potential softlocks to give you a hopefully smooth ride through the space station OPIS!

Please let us know what you think of the changes - we can't wait to hear your opinions! Either on Steam or on our game's Discord and Twitter!

Thank you so much!

notes.title: Update Notes for Version 1.0.1
notes.content:
Hello Archaeologists!

We published a new update fixing two minor issues: the achievement "Explorer" not unlocking and SteamVR popping up on systems that have it installed! 🎉
With this you should now be able to properly get every achievement in the game! We're very sorry for the inconvenience!

And before we give over to the changelog: if you like our game (or even if you didn't like it), please let us know in the Steam reviews! And if you'd like to chat about the game with other players or the developers at Red Koi Box, you can join our Discord as well - thanks! ♥


Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/23NekDsBv9
Follow us on Twitter: http://twitter.com/FaradayProtocol


Changelog

Fixed "Explorer" achievement not unlocking
Fixed SteamVR starting with the game on systems that have it installed

notes.title: Faraday Protocol Out Now!
notes.content:
Good news Everyone! 🎉

Faraday Protocol is finally out! And of tons of different platforms to boot!
Explore OPIS and uncover the mysteries of its governing A.I. IRIS right here on Steam or PlayStation, Xbox and Switch!

The momentous occasion marks the end of our years-long journey to bring the world, puzzles and story of Faraday Protocol to you and everyone hopes you'll have an amazing time exploring the space station! 🌟

If you liked the game, please make sure to leave a review on our Steam Page! It really helps out a lot! ❤

Thank you so much! ❤
